extraction: pypdf; all published PDF pages; includes instructions, options and figure text; excludes unextractable image text
method: NFKC, lowercase, remove /cNNN glyph labels, ASCII words with internal apostrophes; hyphens split; exact surface-form matching; no lemmatization or proper-name exclusion
limitations: Surface-form matches are not lemma coverage, comprehension or exam readiness. Inflections, contractions, names and PDF extraction artifacts may appear missing. This single public exam cannot establish advanced-university coverage.
